facts.text: Deborah mentioned that Jolene's mother enjoyed reading and found comfort in a specific spot in the house.

evidence.quote: She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house.
I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.

facts.text: Deborah stated that travel was also a significant passion for Jolene's mother.

evidence.quote: Travel was also her great passion!

facts.text: Jolene expressed that her snake, Susie, brings her comfort and happiness.

evidence.quote: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.
